name: dragonforge
description: Windows-first AI coding agent orchestrator for safe local development.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dragonforge/shared && npm run build -w @dragonforge/ui && npm run build -w @dragonforge/server && npm run build -w @dragonforge/dashboard
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dragonforge/shared && concurrently -n server,dashboard -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @dragonforge/server" "npm run dev -w @dragonforge/dashboard"
